authority: User confirmed that the Notion materials built for Bablo Hub are verified. The source pages' old Notion verification badges are stale metadata and must not override this explicit confirmation.
ingestionPolicy: Preserve each Notion source ID and URL. Do not flatten same-code courses across universities. Shared reuse requires an explicit target institution/programme/level/semester/course mapping. Never infer equivalence from a matching course code or topic title.
